trigger: Plays immediately after defeating the Reply-All Mothership in Qublox HQ.

lines.speaker: reply-all-mothership
lines.text: ERROR 404: Recipient list truncated... Out of office until... 2099...

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Closed as resolved, dost! Blacklisted the IP range and cleared the inbox!

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Print it! That's a wrap on executive communications. Beautiful coverage.

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, look: the mothership dropped a transit pass to the municipal Render Farm.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Sehaj is over there rendering our trailers! If BEIGE reaches his timeline...

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Then Sehaj will just stare at it in silence. Move out before his export boils.

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Le re! Render Farm transit unlocked. Next district is on my corporate card.
